rows.corpus_definition: To start to rot or become bad to eat.
rows.example_en: This meat will go off if it stays outside.

rows.corpus_definition: To talk about other people's private lives.
rows.example_en: People love to gossip at the office party.

rows.corpus_definition: A large round yellow citrus fruit with a tart pink or red center.
rows.example_en: I drink fresh grapefruit juice every morning for breakfast.

rows.corpus_definition: To understand something that is hard to learn.
rows.example_en: He could not grasp the main idea.

rows.corpus_definition: A strong wish to have more food, money, or things than needed.
rows.example_en: His greed for gold led to his eventual ruin.

rows.corpus_definition: Extreme sadness, especially when someone you love dies.
rows.example_en: He felt great grief after his mother died.

rows.corpus_definition: To crush something into small pieces or powder.
rows.example_en: They grind coffee beans to make fresh drinks.

rows.corpus_definition: To hold something very tightly with your hand.
rows.example_en: She kept a firm grip on the rope.

rows.corpus_definition: A person who sells food and small household items in a shop.
rows.example_en: I bought fresh fruit from the local grocer today.

rows.corpus_definition: To make a low, rough sound in the throat.
rows.example_en: The hungry dog began to growl softly.
